notes: The sensor is modelled as the catalogue 'ping-sensor' (GND, 5V, SIG); the manual's SEN136B5B has the same three pins.

In the image the sensor sits in columns 9, 10, 11 of the upper half of the breadboard (the half labelled f-j in the picture). The catalogue calls that half bank 't' with rows a-e, so sensor pins are given as 9t.e/10t.e/11t.e and wire ends as 9t.d/10t.d/11t.d. Only the strip (column) matters electrically; the exact row is approximate.
The black wire goes to the GND pin next to AREF on the Uno's digital header; it is mapped to catalogue port GND.1.
Hook-up wires are modelled as jumper-wire (male-male). The 5V wire runs from the Uno POWER header 5V pin to the breadboard.
